name: Her Time of the Month!
source:
Your friend / daughter / friend's daughter is on her period! Care for her during her painful first three days; buy her menstrual products and medicine, make her healthy food and drinks, listen to her struggles, and just be there for her.

"Her Time of The Month!" is a semi-educational Visual Novel where you play as three guys that tries to support a girl you care about during her menstruation.

[From [url=https://maho-anpu.itch.io/her-time-of-the-month]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友/女儿/朋友的女儿来月经了！在她痛苦的前三天里照顾她；给她买经期产品和药物，为她准备健康的食物和饮料，倾听她的挣扎，并陪伴在她身边。

“她这个月的时间！”是一部半教育性的视觉小说，你扮演三个男人，试图在你关心的女孩经期期间为她提供支持。

[来自[url=https://maho-anpu.itch.io/her-time-of-the-month]itch.io[/url]]
